pcosPage.title: Understanding Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
pcosPage.subtitle: A comprehensive guide to hormonal imbalances, symptoms, Rotterdam criteria, and non-diagnostic screening.
pcosPage.whatIsPcosDesc: PCOS is a common endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age, characterized by irregular periods, excess androgen levels, and polycystic ovarian morphology.
pcosPage.screeningImportanceDesc: Early pattern identification enables lifestyle modifications, dietary adjustments, and timely clinical consultations to prevent long-term metabolic complications.

hypogonadismPage.title: Understanding Male Hypogonadism
hypogonadismPage.subtitle: Clinical context on testosterone deficiency, energy changes, metabolic markers, and screening.
hypogonadismPage.whatIsHypogonadismDesc: A clinical condition where the body does not produce enough testosterone, impacting energy, vitality, muscle strength, and metabolic regulation.
hypogonadismPage.symptom2: Changes in sex drive and intimacy concerns
hypogonadismPage.symptom3: Decreased muscle strength or loss of lean mass
hypogonadismPage.symptom4: Mood fluctuations, irritability, or brain fog
hypogonadismPage.screeningImportanceDesc: Screening helps differentiate between transient lifestyle fatigue and sustained endocrine deficiency, preparing you for productive physician consultations.
